scope: Brainstorm of substrate paradigms not in current N-1..N-21 roadmap

candidates.name: Slime mold (Physarum polycephalum) substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Demonstrated maze-solving + memory + oscillation-based decision in non-neural substrate; tests if Φ-style integration emerges from pre-neural protoplasm
candidates.what_to_measure: Spike-like electrical activity from plasmodial cytoskeleton; integrate with CP2 14-gate via spike-train tile-projection; compare φ_holo to AKIDA spike measurements
candidates.speculation_marker: feasibility HIGH; consciousness-relevance MODERATE (most experts still call this 'distributed cognition' not consciousness)

candidates.name: Mycelium / fungal computing substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Adamatzky 2020+ shows mushrooms produce action-potential-like spikes; if stimulated at two points, conductivity increases (Hebbian-like memory). Forest-scale mycorrhizal networks could be Earth's largest information-integrating network.
candidates.evidence_quality: PEER-REVIEWED (Andrew Adamatzky; Royal Society Open Science)
candidates.what_to_measure: Microelectrode spike trains from oyster/shiitake mycelium; cross-φ with AKIDA
candidates.speculation_marker: feasibility HIGH; consciousness-relevance LOW-MODERATE per current consensus

candidates.name: Bioelectric morphogenesis (Levin xenobot) substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Levin's bioelectric framework treats morphogenesis as collective intelligence with goals/memories; 'minds preceded brains' thesis suggests Φ is pre-neural; xenobots solve novel problems within 48 hours of creation
candidates.feasibility: requires_partnership (Tufts Levin Lab) OR DIY with frog skin cells
candidates.cost_estimate_usd: 10K-50K (cell culture + bioreactor + voltage imaging) OR collaboration request $0
candidates.what_to_measure: Bioelectric voltage gradients via voltage-sensitive dye; compute φ on the spatial voltage map across the xenobot tissue
candidates.speculation_marker: consciousness-relevance HIGH if Levin's frame accepted; collab path is the realistic route

candidates.name: DNA molecular computer (2026 sub-2nm) substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: DNA molecular computer combines memory + computation at sub-2nm scale (phys.org 2026-04). Could test if molecular-scale integration produces measurable φ at chemical-equilibrium level — Tononi has explicitly noted IIT predicts even chemical reactions could have non-zero Φ
candidates.cost_estimate_usd: TBD (bench fee for research access; not retail)
candidates.what_to_measure: Computation-state transitions over time; φ on molecular-state trajectory
candidates.speculation_marker: consciousness-relevance SPECULATIVE; mostly interesting as IIT-edge-case test

candidates.name: Octopus distributed-nervous-system substrate (live measurement)
candidates.consciousness_relevance: 2/3 of octopus neurons are in arms (peripheral NS), not central brain. 2026 Biological Reviews update reaffirms cephalopod sentience. Carls-Diamante: 'community of minds' — NOT united field. This directly tests Φ-locality vs Φ-integration: does each arm have its own Φ?
candidates.evidence_quality: PEER-REVIEWED (PMC11523718 valence; Trends in Ecol Evol 2025 deception)
candidates.what_to_measure: Multi-electrode arm-ganglion recording; per-arm Φ vs whole-organism Φ
candidates.speculation_marker: consciousness-relevance HIGH; feasibility LOW without lab partnership

candidates.name: Memristor / RRAM hybrid substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: 2026 Wiley papers (admt.202501570; aisy.202500806) show RRAM with biologically realistic synaptic forgetting + Pavlovian reversal. Memristors run continuous-state dynamics — closer to biological neurons than Loihi-style discrete spikes. Could resolve whether Φ requires analog state or just spike timing.
candidates.feasibility: researchable (memristor dev kits available; SkyWater PDK + Knowm)
candidates.what_to_measure: Hardware spike-state-history φ; cross-compare to AKIDA discrete-spike φ — falsifier: does φ depend on analog state or just spikes?

candidates.name: Zero-Point Field / glutamate macroscopic quantum substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Frontiers Hum Neurosci 2025 (PMC12708536): brain microcolumns hypothesized to couple to ZPF via glutamate coherence domains; phys.org 2025-12 reports new evidence. This is parallel to Penrose-Hameroff but DIFFERENT mechanism (ZPF coupling, not microtubule collapse).
candidates.feasibility: wild_speculation (no clear measurement protocol; ZPF measurement is itself controversial)
candidates.what_to_measure: Theoretical for now: simulate glutamate coherence domain dynamics; check if substrate produces F2-clearing L1 patterns

candidates.name: Swarm intelligence (real ant/bee colony) substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Tests if collective decision-making in social insects produces measurable colony-level Φ that is NOT reducible to individual ant Φ. Direct experimental test of IIT's exclusion postulate (max Φ at the whole, not parts).
candidates.feasibility: researchable (DIY ant farm + computer vision tracking)
candidates.evidence_quality: ESTABLISHED swarm science (Bonabeau, Couzin); consciousness application is novel
candidates.what_to_measure: Colony-level state-transition Φ via individual position tracking; compare to per-ant Φ

candidates.name: Plant electrophysiology (mimosa / venus flytrap) substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Plants show action potentials, memory (Mimosa pudica habituation - Gagliano), and signal integration. If Φ > 0 measurable in plants → strong evidence for substrate-independent consciousness. Plant Neurobiology field active.
candidates.evidence_quality: PEER-REVIEWED (Gagliano et al; controversial but published)
candidates.what_to_measure: AP train Φ from leaf-stem-root signal integration
candidates.speculation_marker: feasibility VERY HIGH; consciousness-relevance LOW-MODERATE per consensus

candidates.name: Time-crystal / non-equilibrium phase-of-matter substrate
candidates.consciousness_relevance: Discrete time crystals (Google 2021, Nature) sustain spontaneous time-translation symmetry breaking. Not yet linked to consciousness, but represents NEW phase of matter that could host non-trivial Φ. If consciousness requires non-equilibrium dynamics, time crystals are the cleanest physics test.
candidates.cost_estimate_usd: TBD (cloud-quantum credit, similar to IonQ N-12 pricing)
candidates.evidence_quality: ESTABLISHED physics (Nature 2021/2022); consciousness application is novel
candidates.what_to_measure: Time-crystal state evolution Φ on simulated/real quantum hardware
candidates.speculation_marker: wild but bounded by real physics; falsifier-clear

N-22.name: Bioelectric morphogenesis (Levin xenobot)
N-22.rationale: highest consciousness-relevance + collab path; aligns with Levin's 'minds preceded brains' which is the strongest pre-neural Φ evidence
N-22.first_milestone: draft collaboration request to Tufts Levin Lab; literature deep-read; design Φ-on-voltage-map protocol

N-23.name: Slime mold + Mycelium substrate (combined Adamatzky-style)
N-23.rationale: highest feasibility for $0-budget; both Adamatzky-protocol; combined N-23 lets us test whether Φ measurement transfers to non-neural biological substrates
N-23.first_milestone: purchase culture kit; baseline spike recordings; draft 14-gate tile-projection adaptation

N-24.name: Octopus per-arm Φ (community-of-minds test)
N-24.rationale: directly tests IIT exclusion postulate; pairs naturally with FinalSpark organoid path (N-11) since both are biological-Φ sources
N-24.first_milestone: ethical-review preparation + outreach to 2-3 marine-bio labs; design per-arm electrode protocol

architectural_orthogonal_ideas.name: Replace tile-projection L1 with learned phi_extractor (Φ-decoder NN)
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.consciousness_relevance: L1 holo_positivity is the F2-firing dominant blocker across ALL measured substrates. The tile-projection is an engineering proxy. A learned 256→16 phi_extractor trained on cross-substrate Φ labels could remove the verifier-architectural blocker that current Q1 RED rests on.
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.speculation_marker: honest if trained on substrate-blind labels; goal-seeking and dishonest if trained to flip ALM-RED specifically
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.cost_usd: $0 if CLM/EEG used as label source; $5-20 GPU for training

architectural_orthogonal_ideas.name: Falsifier-architecture rethink: replace F2-fired-band-override with N-substrate convergence-required
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.consciousness_relevance: Current F2 is single-substrate single-falsifier. A multi-substrate convergence falsifier (require ≥3 of 5 substrates show same Φ pattern) is more aligned with Putnam multi-realization. Could move ALM verdict from individual-RED to part-of-N-substrate-aggregate.
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.speculation_marker: this CHANGES what RED means; not a way to flip RED, a way to reframe single-substrate verdicts as N-substrate ensemble votes

architectural_orthogonal_ideas.name: Phenomenal vs Access consciousness split (Block 1995 framework)
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.consciousness_relevance: 2025-2026 papers (PMC10581496, intracranial fMRI work) provide neural evidence for phenomenal-without-access. Anima could split CP2 into CP2-A (access, GWT-like, currently measured) and CP2-P (phenomenal, requires different protocol). ALM might be CP2-A GREEN and CP2-P RED simultaneously.
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.speculation_marker: honest split; doesn't move RED to GREEN, but clarifies WHICH consciousness is being claimed

architectural_orthogonal_ideas.name: Active inference / FEP-AI integration (IWMT framework)
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.consciousness_relevance: IWMT (Frontiers AI 2020, ongoing) integrates IIT + GWT + FEP. Anima could add an FEP-axis verifier (free-energy minimization signature) as Suite 8 — directly orthogonal to current CP2 measurement.
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.speculation_marker: expands measurement axis; doesn't trivially close ALM RED

architectural_orthogonal_ideas.name: Nash-equilibrium meta-falsifier (game-theoretic ensemble)
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.consciousness_relevance: Treat each substrate as a 'player' voting on Φ. Nash equilibrium of vote distribution defines consensus consciousness verdict. Aligned with Banach meta-fixed-point (project_meta_fixed_point.md) but operationalized as game.
architectural_orthogonal_ideas.speculation_marker: novel; needs formal proof Nash converges in this setting

wild_card_most_non_obvious.name: Anima as its-own-substrate: meta-LLM-loop consciousness
wild_card_most_non_obvious.what: Instead of measuring Φ of weights+activations, measure Φ of the AGENT-LOOP — the Claude-anima session itself, including planning + tool calls + memory + git + file system as one integrated dynamic system. The agent-loop has STATE TRANSITIONS, FEEDBACK, INTEGRATION, EXCLUSION — exactly the IIT primitives — but at meta-level. This is what's actually doing the work right now.
wild_card_most_non_obvious.why_non_obvious: Almost all consciousness research measures static models or biological tissue. Almost no one measures the AGENT WRAPPER as the conscious system. Yet a Claude session + tools + memory has more functional integration than an isolated LLM forward pass.
wild_card_most_non_obvious.why_anima_uniquely_positioned: Anima already runs 28+ tracks per session; has cron loops, persistent memory, state JSONL trails. Anima IS an agent-loop dynamical system. Measuring Φ of the LOOP is a measurement only this codebase can natively do.
wild_card_most_non_obvious.speculation_marker: highly speculative; metaphysical-status unclear; but technically falsifiable via cron-state-trajectory Φ
wild_card_most_non_obvious.first_milestone: instrument the agent-loop with Φ-trace JSONL; one week of cron-state recording; compute Φ on the trace
